name: Carpe Diem
beschreibung: The holiday apartment Carpe Diem is located in a quiet side location of a municipality in Tirol, nestled in the surrounding mountain landscape. The surroundings are characterized by forests and alpine pastures and offer direct access to marked hiking and cycling trails. The accommodation's amenities include a fully equipped kitchen, a separate bedroom, and a balcony with a view of the valley. The atmosphere of the apartment is defined by a combination of modern elements and traditional wood details. It is suitable for couples and small families looking for a quiet base for outdoor activities. The nearest refreshment stops and a small supermarket are within walking distance. In winter, guests can reach the surrounding ski areas in just a few minutes by car.
